title: Herdr session started
description: HERDR-5: the reply to `POST /v1/herdr/sessions/{name}/start` (a session the host lists, started headless when it was stopped) and to `POST /v1/herdr/sessions {name}` (a new session in $HOME). Either way the session is running and is now this device's selection, as after `.../select`. `started` is false when it was already running; `created` is true only for a new session. Native credentials only.
